newsitem.title: USA: Ben & Jerry's foresees Q4 shr loss.
newsitem.headline: Ben & Jerry's foresees Q4 shr loss.

text.p: Ice cream maker Ben & Jerry's Homemade Inc said Tuesday it expected a net loss for the fourth quarter to range between $0.13 per share and $0.17 per share, "significantly below" analyst estimates.
It said estimates had foreseen its net income to range between $0.05 and $0.07 per share. Net income for the same period last year was $0.12 per share, it added.
Ben & Jerry's said it nevertheless expected higher net sales in the fourth quarter of 1996 than the comparable quarter last year.
It said it was spending significantly more money on promoting its products during the industry's seasonally low fourth quarter to fend off competition and maintain its position in the U.S. market.
It said the costs it had incurred to enter the European market had also contributed to the loss it was planning to report for the quarter.
